body:
DELIVERED + codex-verified (2 rounds). Commits 8a34de16 (bounded retry) + c8c2e17b (codex round-2: private signal).
objectlog branch creation now transparently + BOUNDEDLY retries when a concurrent peer trim advances the source
retention floor mid-creation, instead of surfacing a bare Conflict to the caller. branch_with_emission is a
bounded loop (MAX_BRANCH_ATTEMPTS=5) around the extracted single-attempt branch_attempt (pin-first,
validate-after-copy, atomic branch.json marker last, objects-first/pin-last rollback all UNCHANGED).

Codex round-1 caught a real robustness bug: retrying on the PUBLIC EngineError::Conflict conflated a floor-advance
with (a) an acquire_epoch CAS-exhaustion Conflict and (b) a rollback-CLEANUP-failure Conflict — the latter would
retry over the deliberately-RETAINED pin/partial state. Fixed (round-2) with a crate-private
enum BranchAttempt { Committed(u64), FloorAdvanced }: the validate-after-copy floor-move returns Ok(None) ->
FloorAdvanced (after full rollback); the loop `match self.branch_attempt(...)? { Committed => return,
FloorAdvanced => continue }` — the `?` propagates EVERY EngineError immediately (unretried), so ONLY a genuine
floor-advance loops. After the cap, a still-FloorAdvanced outcome maps to a clean terminal Conflict (public API
unchanged). cut<=floor stays a terminal Invalid; a rollback-cleanup error surfaces immediately.

Tests (31 substrate, 4 new): retry-succeeds-under-bounded-advance (read_all == retained range, no missing segment);
gives-up-cleanly-under-continuous-trim (terminal Conflict, source fully reclaimable = no leaked pin);
cut-below-advanced-floor rejected Invalid (not retried); and the round-2 guard
branch_does_not_retry_a_rollback_cleanup_conflict (a store whose cleanup delete returns Conflict -> surfaces
immediately, delete_conflicts()==1, retained pin protects the source). Existing single-advance test updated
Conflict->Invalid (semantically faithful under retry). All pqueue-objectlog binaries green; fmt + clippy clean.
summary: bounded transparent branch-creation retry on concurrent-floor-advance, discriminated by a private FloorAdvanced signal (never the public Conflict); codex-verified 2 rounds; 31 tests
